QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_6

question.text: Vindhya Event-Driven Fund (open-ended Cat III) has a 20% investor-level monthly redemption gate, as set out in its PPM. Ms. Priya Shah holds units worth INR 50 crore and submits a redemption request for INR 15 crore. The gate is triggered. How much can she redeem this month?

answer.text: INR 15 crore — the gate does not apply at the investor level
INR 10 crore (20% of her INR 50 crore holding)

explanation.text: The Logic: The stem specifies a 20% investor-level monthly redemption gate. With Ms. Shah's holding at INR 50 crore, the maximum she can redeem this month is 20% x 50 cr = INR 10 cr. The remaining INR 5 cr of her requested amount is not processed this month; treatment of the unfilled portion is governed by the scheme's PPM. The Trap: Option A contradicts the stem (which states an investor-level gate). Option C applies a fictional 50% haircut. Option D misreads 20% as 10%. Note: A redemption gate is a maximum redemption amount permitted in a redemption period (workbook pp. 408-409). Open-ended Cat III schemes may also suspend subscriptions/redemptions under defined conditions (pp. 112, 408-409).
